notes: Registration input, not a run input: Binance's BTC implied-volatility index (BTCBVOLUSDT, about one value a second, ~86,400 rows a day), one daily zip per UTC day (httpblobs, ADR-0233), reshaped to parquet by dskit.onboarding.libs.zipcsv:ZipCsvToParquet under the BVOL layout in transform_params (a header row is sniffed and checked against the declared vendor names; repeated instants are kept and flagged in the inventory note) and laid out <date>.parquet in stream files. transform_params takes no notes key (it feeds the declaration digest, so a comment there would re-pull every file); this note carries the commentary. It is Binance's own options-implied vol, a forward-looking input beside realized vol, not Deribit's DVOL. Time: calc_time_ms is epoch ms (Kalshi candle ts is seconds); the first day (2023-06-20) is partial (ETHBVOL starts 00:11:40Z). LICENCE: Binance Vision data is CC BY-NC-SA (https://data.binance.vision/Binance_Vision-Terms_of_Use.pdf): research use only, not for live trading features. Days: entities_dates, the UTC days from 2023-06-20 (the first BVOL day, probed 2026-10-06; spot klines go back to 2017-08-17, but one shared start keeps the four sources aligned) with lag_days 1, because a day's file appears after the day ends. Backfill pulls start through as_of minus 1 day (2026-10-11 at this as_of) and never changes; acquire --mode live then advances from its own checkpoint to yesterday UTC with no file edit, re-pin or re-register; its first pull also re-tries the last give_up_days of the backfill (a refused day may have been published since). A day not published yet is a refused row, counts toward max_refused (per pull) and is retried by the next live pull and the checkpoint never passes it, until it is more than give_up_days (default 7) old: then it is logged, recorded absent in the checkpoint and skipped for good, so a day Binance never publishes (BVOL has 26) cannot stall the feed. The untouched vendor zip is kept at _raw/<date>.zip and its sha256 is the inventory raw_sha256: compare it with the vendor's <file>.zip.CHECKSUM (ADR-0241 withdrawn; manual spot check per runbook). HEAD sweep 2026-10-06 of every day then declared: 26 days returned 404 (2023-09-25, 2023-10-24, 2024-06-11 to 2024-06-12, 2024-06-30, 2025-12-15 to 2026-01-04), the same 26 for BTC and ETH, so this pull always warns for them; max_refused 31 is those 26 plus 5 of headroom for a day missing at pull time. A day Binance lacks lands as a refused inventory row (suite-binance-files.json warns, never blocks) instead of aborting a pull of over a thousand files. throttle_s 0.1 is polite to a static archive; max_bytes 50 MB is a sanity cap (a daily zip is about 0.4 MB). A changed declaration (start, lag_days or as_of) re-pulls and restarts the live checkpoint at the new backfill end; an unchanged one is a no-op. Register: python -m dskit.onboarding register-source binance-btcbvol --catalog-source binance-btcbvol --connector httpblobs --config @configs/source-binance-btcbvol.json --activate --root <store root>; then acquire --source binance-btcbvol --stream files --mode backfill; validate with configs/suite-binance-files.json; each later day: acquire with --mode live.
